name: Technique Mastery (Combat)
body:
You can quickly switch between techniques as needed.

Prerequisite: Any two technique feats, base attack bonus +5

Benefit: You can switch your technique as a free action. At the start of combat, pick one of your techniques. You start the combat using that technique, even in the surprise round.

Normal: It takes a swift action to begin or switch your techniques.
